pages.title: Dairy
pages.text: Dairy includes milk, cheese, yogurt, and other dairy-based foods.$(br2)Dairy has no default penalty for low intake, but contributes to the overall balance bonus when kept above 75%.$(br2)$(bold)Bonus (all groups above 75%):$()$(br2)$(li)Health Boost I$(li)Regeneration I$(br2)Dairy can be harder to source early game. Milk buckets count, and many food mods add cheese and yogurt options.
